revisionsErrata.title: Adaptable dwelling units, Part 9 seismic, and general updates
revisionsErrata.description: Revision 6 changes include updates to make adaptable dwelling units easier to design and construct, offering greater flexibility that can reduce space requirements and costs beneficial to the project. The changes also clarify seismic requirements for houses and small buildings (Part 9) to support builder understanding and compliance. Additional general updates are also included.

revisionsErrata.title: Adaptable dwelling units
revisionsErrata.description: Revision 5 phases in adaptable dwelling units. Read more about [accessibility requirements in this revision.](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/industry/construction-industry/building-codes-standards/bc-codes/2024-bc-codes/accessibility#adaptable)

revisionsErrata.title: Zero Carbon Step Code
revisionsErrata.description: Revision 4 amends Zero Carbon Step Code to require new buildings to meet at least EL-1.

revisionsErrata.title: Construction of single exit stair buildings
revisionsErrata.description: Revision 3 enables the construction of single exit stair buildings. [BCBC Single Exit Stairs code change convenience copy (PDF, 164 KB)](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/farming-natural-resources-and-industry/construction-industry/building-codes-and-standards/revisions-and-mo/bcbc-revision-3/bcbc_revision_3_single_exit_stair_convenience_copy_2024-08-28.pdf) provides Code language in force and commentary to support implementation. These updates will be consolidated into the BC Building Code 2024.

revisionsErrata.title: Definition of coordinating registered professional and minor corrections
revisionsErrata.description: Revision 2 amends definition of "coordinating registered professional" and minor corrections to numbering and a referenced standard.

revisionsErrata.title: Enabling taller mass timber buildings
revisionsErrata.description:
Revision 1 amends provisions for encapsulated mass timber construction to allow taller mass timber building, additional building occupancies, and changes to encapsulation requirements. [BCBC EMTC code change convenience copy (PDF, 210 KB).](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/farming-natural-resources-and-industry/construction-industry/building-codes-and-standards/revisions-and-mo/bcbc_emtc_code_change_convenience_copy.pdf) Provides Code language in force. These changes will be consolidated into the BC Building Code 2024.
Learn more about [mass timber construction in B.C.](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/industry/construction-industry/mass-timber)
